clue.text: Rounds on grandma, the painter, during diffusions of liquids

parts.note: rounds are circles, so the letter O twice, written as the plural O's
Grandma Moses was a celebrated American folk painter

explanation.surface: Someone circles back on Grandma, the artist, while liquids seep through membranes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' simply sets the two O's above MOSES in this down clue; 'during' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Osmosis is the passage of a solvent through a membrane, a kind of diffusion of liquid.

clue.text: Coming from Peterhead warmed up beforehand

indicators.note: the letters come out of the place name in a new order, so the word is rearranged

explanation.surface: Something arriving from the Scottish port of Peterhead has been warmed in advance.
explanation.walkthrough: Peterhead is a fishing port in north-east Scotland; its nine letters rearrange to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: An oven heated before use has been warmed up in advance.

clue.text: Is leaving remarkably soon, city magnate

indicators.note: remarkably suggests the letters are worked into a striking new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, the letters to be removed from the mix

explanation.surface: A city magnate is departing, surprisingly quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is leaving' says the letters I and S drop out of SOON plus CITY; 'remarkably' then rearranges what is left, CTYOON, into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A tycoon is a wealthy and powerful business magnate.

clue.text: Give temporary assistance when there is flooding on the coast

definitions.text: when there is flooding on the coast

explanation.surface: Help is offered for a while as high water floods the shore.
explanation.definitionFit: To help someone through a lean spell is to carry them across; and literally the sea rises over the land at high water.

clue.text: Highly strung performer?

parts.note: not a nervous artist but a circus act who walks along a wire stretched high in the air

explanation.surface: A nervy, temperamental artist is on stage.
explanation.definitionFit: A funambulist performs on a rope strung high above the ground.

clue.text: Girl changing the guard

indicators.note: changing signals that the letters of the phrase are rearranged

explanation.surface: A young woman watches the changing of the guard.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls the Changing of the Guard ceremony at Buckingham Palace in London.
explanation.definitionFit: A daughter is a female child, a girl.

clue.text: Tosti allowed entry to the old city

indicators.note: the letters are found within the run of the two words, entering into them

explanation.surface: The composer Tosti was let into the ancient city.
explanation.walkthrough: Tosti was an Italian songwriter, a fitting visitor to an Italian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Ostia was the ancient port city of Rome.

clue.text: Choose artist, one who's related to Clytemnestra

parts.note: to choose is to elect
RA, a Royal Academician, is the usual crossword artist

explanation.surface: Pick a painter, one connected to the Greek queen Clytemnestra.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Electra was Clytemnestra's daughter, who avenged her father Agamemnon.

clue.text: Lost a good fellow Raymond

parts.note: a saint is a good person, abbreviated ST
Ray is short for Raymond

explanation.surface: A fine chap called Raymond has lost his way.
explanation.definitionFit: Something gone astray has wandered off and is missing.

clue.text: Haggard permitted to take glove

parts.note: haggard means gaunt, worn and thin
permitted means let

explanation.surface: A worn-looking figure is allowed to pick up a glove.
explanation.definitionFit: A gauntlet is a heavy protective glove, once part of armour.

clue.text: Make light of rings that have been reversed

indicators.note: the rings are turned round, so the word for them is read backwards

parts.note: rings are hoops, here two of them

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses some rings that have been turned the wrong way.
explanation.walkthrough: The plural 'rings' gives two hoops, HOOP HOOP, read backwards as one run.
explanation.definitionFit: To scoff at something is to treat it as trivial and dismiss it.

clue.text: Fireplace right inside waste land

indicators.note: inside puts the letter for right within the word for waste land

parts.note: a heath is open uncultivated land

explanation.surface: A fireplace sits in the middle of a stretch of wilderness.
explanation.definitionFit: A hearth is the floor of a fireplace, by extension the fireside itself.

clue.text: One keeping Eritrean out

indicators.note: out signals that the letters are disordered, put out of place

explanation.surface: Someone from Eritrea is being excluded.
explanation.definitionFit: A retainer is a servant or one who holds on to something, a keeper.

clue.text: Ham on free rein

parts.note: on in the sense of over, as a covering upon something
play is freedom of movement, as in giving a rope plenty of play

explanation.surface: Pork is placed upon a loosely held rein.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ham' as a verb means to overact, not the meat.
explanation.definitionFit: To ham is to act in an exaggerated, theatrical way.

clue.text: After one beast goes rider when there is no coachman

definitions.text: rider when there is no coachman

parts.note: post- is the prefix meaning after
I is the Roman numeral for one
a lion is a great beast

explanation.surface: Once a single animal has passed, a horseman goes along without a driver.
explanation.definitionFit: A postilion rides the leading nearside horse of a carriage that has no driver on the box.

clue.text: Herb's divine first of all

parts.note: divine means heavenly, angelic

indicators.note: first of signals taking only the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: This herb is heavenly above everything else.
explanation.walkthrough: 's' stands for 'is', a link between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Angelica is an aromatic plant used in cooking and candied for cakes.

clue.text: Afternoon trip?

parts.note: trip in the sense of tripping the light fantastic, a dance held at teatime

explanation.surface: An outing in the afternoon is planned.
explanation.definitionFit: A tea dance is a social dance held in the late afternoon with refreshments.

clue.text: First record does confuse the story

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record
I, the Roman numeral one, can stand for first

indicators.note: confuse tells us to jumble the letters of the next word

explanation.surface: An early recording muddles the tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First record' tempts as one piece, but 'First' is the Roman one and 'record' the extended-play disc, joined in reverse order; 'confuse' scrambles 'does'.
explanation.definitionFit: An episode is one instalment or incident in a longer narrative.

clue.text: Quite a distance for a driver

definitions.text: Quite a distance for a driver

parts.words: Quite a distance for a driver
parts.note: reads like a long road journey, but the driver is a golf club and the stretch is the mown grass between tee and green

explanation.surface: A motorist faces a long trip.
explanation.definitionFit: On a golf course, the fairway is the stretch a player aims a tee shot down, a fair way from tee to green.

clue.text: Islander's cup?

parts.note: a resident of the Isle of Wight off England's south coast, and the name of a women's tennis trophy contested by Britain and the USA

explanation.surface: Asks which trophy belongs to an island dweller.
explanation.definitionFit: The Wightman Cup was an annual women's tennis contest; a man from the Isle of Wight would be a Wight man.

clue.text: Classes getting info on time

parts.note: gen is informal British slang for information
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Lessons are getting details about the timetable.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' sets GEN above ERA in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Biological genera are classes or groupings of related species.

clue.text: One garment not finished

indicators.note: not finished means the last letter of the word is cut off

parts.note: a singlet is a vest, a sleeveless undergarment

explanation.surface: A single piece of clothing is left incomplete.
explanation.definitionFit: Single means just one, alone.

clue.text: One sergeant-major in turn having gadget

indicators.note: in places the two short pieces inside the word for turn

parts.note: a go is a turn, as in a board game
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A soldier takes his turn holding a gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: A gismo is an informal word for a clever device or contraption.

clue.text: He lets himself in order to have an income

definitions.text: He lets himself in order to have an income

parts.words: He lets himself in order to have an income
parts.note: lets in the sense of renting out property, not letting oneself into a house

explanation.surface: A man unlocks his own door to collect his earnings.
explanation.definitionFit: A landlord earns money by renting out property to tenants.

clue.text: Delight having to remain with control lever

parts.note: delight means joy
to stick is to stay put, remain

explanation.surface: A gamer's pleasure comes from sticking with the controller.
explanation.definitionFit: A joystick is the hand lever that steers an aircraft or a video game.

clue.text: Rex rings and advocates grid

parts.note: R stands for rex, king
two rings are two letter O's
the Bar is the collective body of barristers

explanation.surface: A king surrounds lawyers with a lattice.
explanation.walkthrough: A roo bar is a metal grille on the front of a vehicle protecting it from kangaroos, as used in Australia.
explanation.definitionFit: A roo bar is a strong metal frame fixed over a vehicle's front, a protective grille.

clue.text: Carefree having one braid out of place

indicators.note: out of place says the letters are displaced into a new order

explanation.surface: A relaxed person has a single plait askew.
explanation.definitionFit: Debonair means confident and nonchalant, with a light-hearted air.
